description: AiTrillion connects your e-commerce store to ChatGPT so you can ask about your own data in plain English — your loyalty program, earning rules and rewards, membership plans, product ratings, and store reports. The connection is strictly read-only: it can view and summaries your data but can never create, edit, or delete anything. You connect once and log in securely, and your data stays private to your store.

defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my store's key metrics.
How do customers earn loyalty points in my store?
Show me my loyalty members and their available point balances.
